title: Object Storage: resumption fee
content:
Object Storage resumption fee is defined as follows: Fee for restoring a suspended holding; USD decimal.

| Contract tier | Resumption fee |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | resumption fee: 0 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | resumption fee: 0 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | resumption fee: 0 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | resumption fee: 0 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | resumption fee: 0 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the resumption fee entry is 0.
